visualCharacteristics.purpose: Pill tabs (e.g. Features / In The Box) whose panels are horizontally scrolling carousels of tall photo tiles with overlaid text
visualCharacteristics.summary: Pill tabs whose panels are horizontal carousels of tall photo tiles with overlaid text (first tile text-only)

contentPattern.summary: Tabs: 'Features' (intro tile + 10 feature tiles) and 'In The Box' (intro tile + 5 item tiles)
contentPattern.structure: one row per tab; cell 1: tab label; cell 2: panel content as rich text. Each tile starts with its image, followed by its H3 title and paragraph; any heading/text before the first image becomes a text-only intro tile

reuseGuidance: Use for tabbed feature or what's-in-the-box showcases made of image tiles. For tabbed product listings with prices and a View all link use tabs-product-cards; for plain tabbed text use the base tabs block.
